title: Kiritani Haruka — Expressing "Who We Are"〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, there you all are!
Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Perfect.
We were hoping to discuss something with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Discuss?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great, Shizuku! They picked your design!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Congratulations, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were so worried if you'd be able to design what you were hoping for, but we're glad you found the answer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So am I. Thank you for giving me such wonderful advice that time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What advice?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I came here to ask what kind of outfit I should design when I still wasn't sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku and the others were kind enough to give me some wonderful hints.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, all we really did was listen to your story. You're the one who ultimately found the answer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's right. So, how are your actual outfits coming along?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're still working out the details.
Shizuku's been taking care of deciding what fabric and materials to use.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're also asking to see which of our fans would like to help us make them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I hope you get a lot of offers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We've actually gotten a lot already!
Some even seem to be adept tailors and dressmakers in their own right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, really. They've sent us some of their past works to show us what they can do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The photos of the figure skating outfits and wedding dresses probably surprised us the most.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow... It sounds like some of your fans are incredible people.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are they professionals by any chance?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, they said that it's just a hobby and that they made these for their friends and family.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I... I don't believe it...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means your outfit's gonna look absolutely incredible if you have these people working on your side!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I've been getting excited just thinking that we get to work with such talented people.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's great. You get another chance to create something together with your fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was worried about showing our fans what goes on behind the scenes during our event the other day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you were right in the end, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Idols are able to spread hope to everyone involved in a show, not just the audience.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even when I was in ASRUN, I felt that our fans were the ones keeping us propped up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I was reminded of just how important our fans are to us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As we try to spread hope to them, we receive some of their energy as they cheer for us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're the ones who keep us on stage.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The relationship between idols and their fans is such a beautiful thing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is♪
Not only that, you girls built your event from the ground up with your fans and made it a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She's right.
You all came together to make it a reality...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means you might be able to do something truly special together someday♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Something truly special?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haha.
I hope that ends up being a big event in real life.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, me too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I still don't know if the way we've been doing things is the right answer or not.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If anything, I feel like we're being spoiled a little by our fans' passion.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to keep being “an idol who can spread hope to everyone”. I never want to lose that spark again.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I have to keep giving back to them.
I can't let the energy they've given me go to waste...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can.)
